identity.title: The Origin of the X-Ray Emission in Two Well-aligned Extragalactic Jets: The Case for IC/CMB

paper_type_evidence.quote: PKS 1510$-$089 has also been observed by ALMA; we reduced archival band 4, 6, and 7 observations from project 2016.1.00116.S.

evidence.quote: At the distance of OJ 287 ($z$ = 0.306) 1$''$ corresponds to a projected distance of 4.36 kpc
for PKS 1510$-$089 ($z=0.36$) it corresponds to 4.87 kpc

question.value: Is the X-ray emission of the kpc-scale jets of OJ 287 and PKS 1510-089 due to IC/CMB, as tested by the predicted minimum Fermi/LAT gamma-ray flux?

evidence.quote: We have used archival multiwavelength observations to make precise predictions for the expected minimum flux in the GeV band, assuming that the X-ray emission from the kpc-scale jet is entirely due to the IC/CMB process.
we analyzed relatively deep Band 3 observations taken from project 2016.1.00406.S where OJ 287 served as phase calibrator

provided.value: Gamma-ray minimum-flux SED via progressive binning

evidence.quote: We utilized the progressive binning method to search for the minimum flux or upper limit in the five canonical Fermi/LAT energy bands

provided.value: Jet X-ray fluxes (re-analysis of OBSID 11432 for PKS 1510-089)

evidence.quote: We re-analyzed a deeper 45 ks ACIS-S observation from (OBSID: 11432)

provided.value: L and C band A-configuration archival data for PKS 1510-089

evidence.quote: we analyzed historical VLA observations at L and C band in A-configuration from project codes AH938 and AO070

what.value: OJ 287 radio fluxes at 1.4, 4.8, 8.6 GHz; HST upper limit; Chandra flux

evidence.quote: the radio fluxes for the entire large-scale jet at 1.4 GHz, 4.8 GHz, and 8.6 GHz were taken from (cite: marscher2011)
$^{b}$ (cite: sambruna2004), otherwise this paper

pipeline_or_manual.value: ALMA pipeline via scriptForPI.py, then self-calibration

evidence.quote: The data were initially processed using the ‘scriptForPI.py’ script with CASA in pipeline mode.

self_calibration.value: 1-2 rounds phase-only, then one amplitude and phase round

evidence.quote: we applied 1-2 rounds of phase-only self-calibration before a final round of amplitude and phase self-calibration.

continuum_subtraction.value: core subtraction in the uv plane with uvsub using CLEAN core model, then re-CLEAN

evidence.quote: subtracted these from the visibility data using the CASA task `uvsub`.
The final RMS of these images was 7.3 $\times$ 10$^{-5}$ Jy, 1.0 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$ Jy and 1.6 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$ Jy
The method used is identical to that described in (cite: meyer14) and (cite: meyer15) which we refer to for further details.

what.value: IC/CMB spectrum predicted by shifting the synchrotron spectrum

evidence.quote: shifted in frequency and luminosity according to the formulae in (cite: geo06)

unstated_but_needed: Imaging parameters (weighting, robust, cell, image size, masks, deconvolver) for ALMA images
Which ALMA execution blocks and dates were used
How core-subtracted jet flux was integrated (region) and flux uncertainties
Fermi source model and likelihood settings

method.value: Calibrate and self-calibrate, CLEAN, subtract core model with uvsub, re-CLEAN

evidence.quote: We then ran a final round of CLEAN on the now-subtracted MS file to produce the image without core emission.

method.value: MARX PSF simulation of core subtracted from the jet; power-law fit in Sherpa

evidence.quote: We conducted PSF simulations of the core in order to account for its contribution of flux to the inner jet.

method.value: Weekly light curve reordered by TS, progressive recombination, minimum flux or upper limit per band

evidence.quote: We then adopt the absolute minimum flux or upper limit in each band individually over the whole recombined binning to generate the minimum SED.

method.value: Shift radio-optical synchrotron SED to match X-rays; compare with Fermi minimum SED; derive B/delta and delta

evidence.quote: the inverse Compton spectrum is essentially a copy of the synchrotron spectrum, shifted in frequency and luminosity

assumptions.value: X-ray emission entirely IC/CMB; gamma_min = 10; H0=73, OmegaM=0.27, OmegaL=0.73

evidence.quote: an assumed minimum electron Lorentz factor $\gamma_\mathrm{min}$ of 10
The data were calibrated using standard procedures in CASA version 5.3.0
The analysis was conducted using CIAO 4.11.
We used the toolset MARX, which provides ray tracing routines for the Chandra optics to simulate the PSF.
We also fit the extracted jet spectrum as a power-law in SHERPA

results_numeric.quantity: PKS 1510-089 Chandra jet flux at 1 keV

evidence.quote: resulting in an estimate of 14.8 $\pm$ 0.2 nJy at 1 keV
yielding a spectral index $\alpha$ = 0.56 $\pm$ 0.11
the required Doppler factors $\delta$ are 22.5 and 19 to match the gamma-ray minimum level.

results_numeric.quantity: Minimum IC/CMB jet power OJ 287 / PKS 1510-089

evidence.quote: $1.8\times 10^{45}$ and $1.2\times 10^{45}$ erg s$^{-1}$ for OJ 287 and PKS 1510$-$089 respectively

findings_qualitative.value: OJ 287 shows a plateau in the Fermi progressive-binning curve consistent with a steady IC/CMB floor; PKS 1510-089 shows none.

evidence.quote: In the case of OJ 287, we do see signs of such ‘plateau’ behavior consistent with a steady flux level in the highest energy band

claims.hypothesis: The minimum Fermi/LAT flux matches the IC/CMB prediction from the radio-to-X-ray SED
claims.experiment: Progressive binning of Fermi data compared with SED-shifted IC/CMB predictions
claims.result: Minimum fluxes agree extremely well with predictions for both jets
claims.finding: IC/CMB emission is detected for OJ 287 and PKS 1510-089; the case is stronger for OJ 287

evidence.quote: the Fermi/LAT minimum flux values agree extremely well with the IC/CMB model predictions based on the radio to X-ray data for both jets.

limitations_admitted.value: For PKS 1510-089 the minimum may be a low state of the core matching IC/CMB by chance.

evidence.quote: it cannot be ruled out that the minimum gamma-ray flux level is due to a low state of the variable core which only matches the IC/CMB prediction by chance.

referee_caveats_inferred: Minimum-flux SED mixes different epochs per band, and the core may contribute
No quantitative goodness-of-fit between prediction and data
ALMA role is minor: OJ 287 jet was undetected and only PKS 1510-089 mm fluxes were derived

data_public_as_stated.value: Archival ALMA, VLA, Chandra and Fermi data

evidence.quote: we reduced archival band 4, 6, and 7 observations from project 2016.1.00116.S

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: ~50-200 GB for ALMA, VLA and Chandra, plus Fermi photon data
reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and the workflow are outlined, but many parameters are missing and the ALMA part is minor.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The recipe is incomplete and the main result rests on a Fermi comparison with qualitative agreement.

companion_papers.why: Earlier Fermi limits on IC/CMB and the SED-shift model
